title: Chain Accessories
body:
#### **Here you will find the data pack of the project. The resource pack is available [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chain-accessories-resource-pack).**

Ever wanted to **wear chains** in Minecraft? This project makes it happen — no mods needed.

It uses a **data pack + resource pack** combo that lets you **equip** iron or copper **chains** as a **head accessory**. Just _sneak and drop a chain_, and it’ll automatically move to your head like a **wearable item**.

The resource pack changes the chain’s **3D model** so it actually looks like you’re wearing it — clean and perfect for screenshots or roleplay.

What it does:
- Lets you **wear chains on your head** (iron and copper variants).
- Uses only a data pack and a resource pack - no mods needed.

Why download it:
- Because wearing armor is boring — this gives your character style and personality without breaking the vanilla vibe.

Critical Info:
- Includes both data pack and resource pack (both required), make sure you put each one in its folder
- No performance impact
- **To wear a chain, drop it while sneaking and it will apply to your head**
- Don't forget to download the resource pack [here](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/chain-accessories-resource-pack), or at the _Dependencies_ panel on this project after clicking on the latest version of the data pack.

A simple but awesome cosmetic tweak — wear your chains proudly.
